versions.changelog:
- Initial release of Plane Seat Picker.
- Decodes aircraft seat numbers to position (window/middle/aisle, left/right) for major aircraft families.
- Flags problem rows (limited recline, near lavatories/galleys, exit/bulkhead trade-offs, missing windows).
- Provides seat selection strategies tailored for solo travelers, couples, families (including infants/toddlers), and flight types (red-eye/daytime).
- Includes quick-access aircraft layout facts and comparison table.
- Explains seat traps and common booking pitfalls to help avoid bad choices.
